name: Damage Inc. NY

evidence.note: 89 North lists 'The Big Four Tribute Night' on Oct 3 with Chaotica, a Slayer tribute and Damage Inc.
Agent page: Damage Inc. NY, formed in 2013 and based on Long Island.
Band post uses mosh-pit and headbanger tags.

dancing.notes: A heavy metal tribute night. Fans headbang and mosh up front; it is not partner, line or party dancing.

description: A Long Island-based Metallica tribute band, formed in 2013, that recreates Metallica's thrash metal concerts.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). A different national Metallica tribute also uses 'Damage Inc' (damageinc.us, formed 2004). The Long Island band fits the 89 North gig.
